rows: can i pay for seller pass through mtn momo
Paying for coverage
Yes. Seller Pass can be paid by mobile money, either MTN MoMo or Airtel Money. Send the payment, then submit the payment reference on the subscription page.

can my store get a verified seller badge
Seller badge tiers: Verified Seller, Gold Partner, Platinum Partner
Yes. A store earns Verified Seller after 6 or more months of continuous paid Seller Pass coverage.

does nextastore keep my money when i order
Paying for an order as a buyer at checkout
No. NextaStore does not take or process payment from buyers. Checkout only sends each seller an order request.
